name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted SEO suite for keyword research, rank tracking, backlinks, site audits and AI visibility, with email and password accounts.

alerts.message: SEO data needs a DataForSEO API key (the Base64 credential) or a treg API token: set DATAFORSEO_API_KEY or TREG_API_TOKEN and redeploy.
The first visitor creates the administrator account and registration then closes. Open the app and create it right after deployment.
